hints.title: Stream Frequency Counter
hints.text: Maintain an integer counter tracking consecutive arrivals of value.

hints.title: Counter Reset on Mismatch
hints.text: Increment the counter when the incoming number matches value, and reset it to zero otherwise.

hints.title: Threshold Comparison
hints.text: Return true if the consecutive counter is at least k, false otherwise.

hints.title: Consecutive Counter Stream Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Buffering all incoming stream values wastes linear memory up to 10^5 elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Tracks only running consecutive count without storing full history.
